The University of Manitoba invites applications for a Canada Impact+ Research Chair in Artificial Intelligence, which provides Chairholders and their research teams with an award of up to $8 million CAD over eight years ($1 million per year) with potential for extension. A successful candidate would be appointed to a tenured, full-time position at the rank of Full Professor or Associate Professor with opportunity for promotion.
